blockers.title: Operating within single-service boundaries rather than multi-service architecture
blockers.whyItBlocks: Promotion to Consultant at Capgemini India requires owning end-to-end multi-service architectures and high-ambiguity problem spaces. Working solely on minor service enhancements blocks advancement.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Present technical design documents (RFCs) showing architecture across at least 2-3 decoupled microservices, database schema migrations, and event-driven pipelines.

blockers.title: Technical output not explicitly tied to business OKRs or cost savings
blockers.whyItBlocks: Committees require demonstrable business metrics at Consultant—such as infrastructure cost reductions, conversion lift, or significant API throughput milestones.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Quantify revenue or infrastructure impact: e.g., 'Reduced cloud compute spend by ₹25L/year by optimizing DynamoDB access patterns' or 'Reduced checkout latency by 180ms'.

blockers.title: No skip-level visibility or committee advocacy beyond direct manager
blockers.whyItBlocks: At Capgemini India, Director-level calibration committees review Consultant promotions. If your Engineering Director or peer tech leads have not heard of your work, your manager cannot defend the case.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Lead brownbag tech talks, contribute to org-wide architecture reviews, and present key quarter deliverables in departmental town halls.

blockers.title: Org headcount quotas or constrained promotion budget in business unit
blockers.whyItBlocks: Many organizations enforce strict bell curves and tier-wise budget caps per cycle. Even solid performers get deferred when the org quota is exhausted by critical business units.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Demonstrate mission-critical indispensability to core business initiatives and align with management on multi-cycle promo pipeline priority.

blockers.title: Absence of proactive mentorship and talent force-multiplication
blockers.whyItBlocks: Consultant engineers must multiply their team's output. Working as a brilliant solo contributor without mentoring juniors or elevating team coding standards triggers a calibration block.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Document regular 1:1 mentorship of 1-2 junior engineers, authored team runbooks, and leading postmortem reviews without blame.

blockers.title: Recent rating dip or manager turnover right before calibration cycle
blockers.whyItBlocks: A manager transition within 3-4 months of the cycle often delays promotions because the new manager lacks historical context and credibility to defend the candidate in committee.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Maintain an up-to-date running 'Brag Document' with verified timestamps, peer recommendations, and measurable outcomes to hand off to the new manager.

promotionRequirements.scope: Technical architect or engagement delivery lead for multi-million dollar client programs.
promotionRequirements.impact: Maintains client account retention and high CSAT scores.
promotionRequirements.influence: Guides 15+ engineers; shapes practice technical assets.
evidence: Client renewal documentation
Account growth case studies

blockers.title: Scope limited to single team roadmap instead of org-wide technical strategy
blockers.whyItBlocks: Staff-level (Senior Consultant) at Capgemini India requires driving strategic initiatives across 3+ squads or an entire business domain. Managing single-team sprints is considered senior IC scope, not staff.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Architect and drive a multi-team cross-cutting initiative (e.g. unified authentication, migration to event-driven core, org-wide security compliance).

blockers.title: No VP/Director-level business case justifying the Staff Engineer seat
blockers.whyItBlocks: Staff-level titles are strictly headcount-controlled at Capgemini India. Without an open organizational business need for a Staff Engineer to govern a major initiative, the packet is frozen.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Collaborate with your Director/VP to identify an open multi-million rupee architectural bottleneck and formally step into the tech lead role for it.

blockers.title: Failure to de-risk high-ambiguity projects before committee review
blockers.whyItBlocks: Staff candidates are expected to anticipate technical failures, platform scaling bottlenecks, and compliance vulnerabilities 6-12 months before they materialize.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Provide disaster recovery drills, automated failure-injection tests (chaos engineering), and long-term tech roadmaps adopted across the business pillar.

blockers.title: Lack of vocal sponsorship across peer Staff/Principal engineers in calibration
blockers.whyItBlocks: Staff promo packets must pass review by a centralized Staff Calibration Council. If existing Staff/Principal engineers review the packet and vote neutral or negative, promotion is denied.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Partner with Staff+ engineers across the company on RFC reviews, engineering councils, and invite them to critique your high-impact design proposals early.

blockers.title: Over-indexing on coding tickets while neglecting organizational influence
blockers.whyItBlocks: Senior engineers who remain heads-down in IDE without driving company RFC standards, interviewing, or shaping engineering culture cannot cross into Staff level.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Author company-wide engineering best-practice standards, speak at internal tech summits, and lead interviewer training programs.

blockers.title: Packet lacks proof of operating at Staff level for 12+ sustained months
blockers.whyItBlocks: The bar for Staff promotion is 'ready now with undeniable sustained track record'. Any perception that the candidate is merely 'promising' results in immediate deferral.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Compile 4 quarters of measurable cross-team deliverables where you were recognized by peer managers as the de facto technical authority.

promotionRequirements.scope: Telecom, enterprise, or digital project ticket resolution and unit testing.
promotionRequirements.impact: Achieves 100% project billing compliance with clean timesheets.
promotionRequirements.influence: Active participation in project scrums.
evidence: Utilization confirmation
Internal certification completion

blockers.title: Executing only bounded tasks without independent architectural ownership
blockers.whyItBlocks: At Tech Mahindra, promoting from Associate Software Engineer to Software Engineer requires moving past guided ticket execution. Engineers who need continuous supervision or detailed pseudo-code from senior peers are rated as still operating at entry level.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Provide 2-3 production feature deliveries where you took fuzzy user stories, wrote RFC/technical design docs independently, and drove execution with minimal senior oversight.

blockers.title: Code velocity high but system impact and reliability unmeasured
blockers.whyItBlocks: Submitting many PRs is insufficient for Software Engineer at Tech Mahindra. Calibration committees look for production reliability, latency improvements, and zero-defect deployments rather than pure line count.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Include Datadog/Prometheus dashboards or launch metrics demonstrating 99.9% uptime, reduced query latency, or zero P0 regressions across your owned modules.

blockers.title: Lack of multi-quarter sustained performance evidence
blockers.whyItBlocks: Calibration guidelines require 6 to 12 consecutive months of consistently performing at Software Engineer expectations before promotion is granted ('promo is a lagging indicator, not a reward for potential').
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Document 2 consecutive performance review cycles rated 'Exceeds Expectations' with written peer feedback confirming you were already functioning at Software Engineer.

blockers.title: Work confined within immediate pod without cross-functional visibility
blockers.whyItBlocks: At calibration, committee members outside your immediate team evaluate your packet. If your technical contribution is unknown to neighboring tech leads, the nomination lacks cross-team backing.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Secure written endorsements and code review feedback from tech leads in upstream/downstream collaborating squads.

blockers.title: Weak collaboration hygiene or defensive code review posture
blockers.whyItBlocks: Tech Mahindra values constructive code review culture. Engineers who push back defensively on constructive feedback or fail to review peer PRs promptly fail the culture calibration bar.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Show evidence of high-quality, empathetic PR reviews for teammates, active participation in sprint retrospectives, and onboarding help for incoming interns or junior peers.

blockers.title: Packet missing required calibration artifacts and manager sponsorship
blockers.whyItBlocks: A poorly constructed promo packet lacking concrete diffs, customer testimonials, and proactive manager advocacy in calibration leads to deferral to the subsequent cycle.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Draft your promo packet with your manager 8 weeks before cycle cutoff, conducting a dry run review with an external staff engineer.

hiringRoutes.notes: Primary R&D hiring route for Mahindra Research Valley (MRV) and automotive plants.

promotionRequirements.scope: Engineers vehicle systems for flagship SUV platforms (Scorpio-N, XUV700, Thar, BE.05 electric origin).
promotionRequirements.impact: Achieves Global NCAP 5-star crash safety criteria or optimizes NVH (noise, vibration, harshness) metrics.
promotionRequirements.influence: Coordinates across vehicle integration squads and testing facilities.
evidence: ECN sign-off on series production vehicles
Validation reports approved by test track head

blockers.title: Operating within single-service boundaries rather than multi-service architecture
blockers.whyItBlocks: Promotion to MGR at Mahindra requires owning end-to-end multi-service architectures and high-ambiguity problem spaces. Working solely on minor service enhancements blocks advancement.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Present technical design documents (RFCs) showing architecture across at least 2-3 decoupled microservices, database schema migrations, and event-driven pipelines.

blockers.title: Technical output not explicitly tied to business OKRs or cost savings
blockers.whyItBlocks: Committees require demonstrable business metrics at MGR—such as infrastructure cost reductions, conversion lift, or significant API throughput milestones.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Quantify revenue or infrastructure impact: e.g., 'Reduced cloud compute spend by ₹25L/year by optimizing DynamoDB access patterns' or 'Reduced checkout latency by 180ms'.

blockers.title: No skip-level visibility or committee advocacy beyond direct manager
blockers.whyItBlocks: At Mahindra, Director-level calibration committees review MGR promotions. If your Engineering Director or peer tech leads have not heard of your work, your manager cannot defend the case.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Lead brownbag tech talks, contribute to org-wide architecture reviews, and present key quarter deliverables in departmental town halls.

blockers.title: Org headcount quotas or constrained promotion budget in business unit
blockers.whyItBlocks: Many organizations enforce strict bell curves and tier-wise budget caps per cycle. Even solid performers get deferred when the org quota is exhausted by critical business units.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Demonstrate mission-critical indispensability to core business initiatives and align with management on multi-cycle promo pipeline priority.

blockers.title: Absence of proactive mentorship and talent force-multiplication
blockers.whyItBlocks: MGR engineers must multiply their team's output. Working as a brilliant solo contributor without mentoring juniors or elevating team coding standards triggers a calibration block.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Document regular 1:1 mentorship of 1-2 junior engineers, authored team runbooks, and leading postmortem reviews without blame.

blockers.title: Recent rating dip or manager turnover right before calibration cycle
blockers.whyItBlocks: A manager transition within 3-4 months of the cycle often delays promotions because the new manager lacks historical context and credibility to defend the candidate in committee.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Maintain an up-to-date running 'Brag Document' with verified timestamps, peer recommendations, and measurable outcomes to hand off to the new manager.

promotionRequirements.scope: Platform lead for major automotive system module across EV or ICE platforms.
promotionRequirements.impact: Drives vehicle launch readiness within targeted time-to-market and BOM budget.
promotionRequirements.influence: Leads cross-functional squad of 10+ engineers and validation analysts.
evidence: Homologation approval achieved on schedule
BOM cost efficiency audit passed

blockers.title: Scope limited to single team roadmap instead of org-wide technical strategy
blockers.whyItBlocks: Staff-level (SMGR) at Mahindra requires driving strategic initiatives across 3+ squads or an entire business domain. Managing single-team sprints is considered senior IC scope, not staff.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Architect and drive a multi-team cross-cutting initiative (e.g. unified authentication, migration to event-driven core, org-wide security compliance).

blockers.title: No VP/Director-level business case justifying the Staff Engineer seat
blockers.whyItBlocks: Staff-level titles are strictly headcount-controlled at Mahindra. Without an open organizational business need for a Staff Engineer to govern a major initiative, the packet is frozen.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Collaborate with your Director/VP to identify an open multi-million rupee architectural bottleneck and formally step into the tech lead role for it.

blockers.title: Failure to de-risk high-ambiguity projects before committee review
blockers.whyItBlocks: Staff candidates are expected to anticipate technical failures, platform scaling bottlenecks, and compliance vulnerabilities 6-12 months before they materialize.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Provide disaster recovery drills, automated failure-injection tests (chaos engineering), and long-term tech roadmaps adopted across the business pillar.

blockers.title: Lack of vocal sponsorship across peer Staff/Principal engineers in calibration
blockers.whyItBlocks: Staff promo packets must pass review by a centralized Staff Calibration Council. If existing Staff/Principal engineers review the packet and vote neutral or negative, promotion is denied.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Partner with Staff+ engineers across the company on RFC reviews, engineering councils, and invite them to critique your high-impact design proposals early.

blockers.title: Over-indexing on coding tickets while neglecting organizational influence
blockers.whyItBlocks: Senior engineers who remain heads-down in IDE without driving company RFC standards, interviewing, or shaping engineering culture cannot cross into Staff level.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Author company-wide engineering best-practice standards, speak at internal tech summits, and lead interviewer training programs.

blockers.title: Packet lacks proof of operating at Staff level for 12+ sustained months
blockers.whyItBlocks: The bar for Staff promotion is 'ready now with undeniable sustained track record'. Any perception that the candidate is merely 'promising' results in immediate deferral.
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Compile 4 quarters of measurable cross-team deliverables where you were recognized by peer managers as the de facto technical authority.

fresherPrograms.testOrPortal: TCS iON Platform (National Qualifier Test — strictly proctored: disabled copy-paste, per-section locked timers, negative marking on cognitive sub-sections)

eligibility.backlogPolicy: No active backlogs allowed at the time of appearing
eligibility.gapYearPolicy: Max 24 months academic gap permitted with justification
eligibility.notes: Standard 60% / 6.0 CGPA throughout 10th, 12th, and graduation without active backlogs.

selectionProcess.stage: TCS NQT Programming Logic & Hands-on Coding

training.notes: TCS Xplore Pre-Onboarding Foundation: Mandatory Coursework & Proctored Assessment (CPA). Scoring >80% unlocks early joining priority (Batch A July) and ₹40,000–₹60,000 one-time incentive; failure to pass delays joining window by 3–6 months. Followed by 3-month Initial Learning Program (ILP) at TCS Trivandrum / virtual.

seasons.notes: Primary drives August to October. High Onboarding Delay Risk: Offers are disbursed across 3–8 month staggered onboarding batches (Batch A July, Batch B October, Batch C March of following year) based on project demand pipeline.

conditions: Wings1 high performer clearance or internal Digital elevation exam
Consistently rated 4+ out of 5 in project appraisals

blockers.title: Wings1 DCA Clearance Delay
blockers.whyItBlocks: Internal elevation to Digital compensation band mandates clearing internal DCA (Digital Capability Assessment).
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Complete internal Python/Java track certifications and submit top-tier DCA test scores.

blockers.title: Onboarding Batch Stagger Delay
blockers.whyItBlocks: Mass campus hires face 3 to 8 months of idle waiting time between graduation and actual Date of Joining (DOJ).
blockers.evidenceToCounter: Score 80%+ in TCS Xplore Proctored Assessment (CPA) before graduation to secure earliest Batch A joining allocation.

trajectory.fastTrackNote: Clearing Wings1 DCA Articulation exam promotes to Digital band within 12 months.
lateralExits: Service-to-product transitions as Junior Software Engineer at fintech or mid-tier product firms.

L3_ENTRY.label: Entry Level / Associate
L3_ENTRY.description: New graduates and early-career engineers. Focused on execution of bounded tasks with guidance.
L3_ENTRY.terminalExpectation: Up-or-out expected at most Big Tech within 24-36 months.

L4_MID.label: Mid-Level Software Engineer
L4_MID.description: Fully autonomous individual contributor. Owns end-to-end features, unblocks self, designs sub-systems.
L4_MID.terminalExpectation: Many companies require promotion to Senior (L5) within 3-5 years (semi-terminal).

L5_SENIOR.label: Senior Software Engineer
L5_SENIOR.description: Career-terminal level for ~70% of engineers. Owns complex system architecture, sets standards, mentors juniors.
L5_SENIOR.terminalExpectation: Fully terminal level. Engineers can stay here indefinitely with strong performance.

L6_STAFF.label: Staff Engineer / Tech Lead
L6_STAFF.description: Multi-team and org-wide technical leadership. Defines multi-quarter roadmaps, solves ambiguous cross-cutting problems.
L6_STAFF.terminalExpectation: Requires demonstrated business-critical scope. High stall rate (~80% fail to advance further).

L7_PRINCIPAL.label: Principal / Senior Staff Engineer
L7_PRINCIPAL.description: Company-wide or business-unit technical authority. Steers technology strategy, interfaces with VP/C-suite.
L7_PRINCIPAL.terminalExpectation: Fewer than 3-5% of company engineers reach this level.

L8_DISTINGUISHED.label: Distinguished Engineer / Fellow
L8_DISTINGUISHED.description: Industry-level technical luminary. Influences industry standards, patents, core company platform foundations.
L8_DISTINGUISHED.terminalExpectation: Appointed by executive committee. < 0.5% of engineering population.

M1_MANAGER.label: Engineering Manager
M1_MANAGER.description: Direct people manager for 6-12 engineers. Responsible for delivery, career growth, team health, and execution.
M1_MANAGER.terminalExpectation: Can be terminal at mid-size companies, progression requires scaling team or multiple pods.

M2_SENIOR_MANAGER.label: Senior Engineering Manager
M2_SENIOR_MANAGER.description: Second-line manager (manages managers or large org of 20-40 engineers). Strategic roadmap and talent calibration.
M2_SENIOR_MANAGER.terminalExpectation: High bar, requires managing complex cross-functional group.

M3_DIRECTOR.label: Director of Engineering
M3_DIRECTOR.description: Executive leader of an entire engineering pillar (50-150+ engineers). Accountable for organizational P&L/business outcomes.
